description: Implementation of internal cryptographic functions for the Abseil library's random number generator, including AES-based round functions, block shuffling, and permutation routines.

classes.name: Vector128
classes.description: A software implementation of a 128-bit vector register using four uint32_t elements, aligned to 16 bytes.

methods.name: Vector128Load
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes from memory into a Vector128 object.

methods.name: Vector128Store
methods.description: Stores a Vector128 object into memory.

methods.name: AesRound
methods.description: Performs one AES round transformation on a Vector128 state with a given round key.

methods.name: BlockShuffle
methods.description: Performs a fixed permutation (shuffle) of 16 128-bit blocks in the state array.

methods.name: FeistelRound
methods.description: Executes a Feistel round using AES-based subrounds on blocks of the state.

methods.name: Permute
methods.description: Applies multiple Feistel rounds and block shuffles to permute the internal state.

methods.name: SwapEndian
methods.description: Pre-swaps byte order of the state for big-endian architectures to enable native loads.
